newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA LEU EASING DOWN VS DLR, MARKET IDLE.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA LEU EASING DOWN VS DLR, MARKET IDLE.

text.p: Romania's leu closed marginally weaker at about 7,000/200 to the dollar on Monday against some 6,800/7,300 at opening with interbank trading subdued, dealers said.
"There were few deals with leu heading gently for new lows," said one trader with a foreign bank.
"Trading with clients is also thin as most exporters are sitting on their dollars," said another trader.
Banks' quotes weakened slightly but continued to show a wide range of leu-dollar prices between 6,200/00 to 7,400/8,400 against 6,000/100 to 7,400/8,400 in early trading.
Dealers said the money market remained liquid with short- term prices hovering near 215/230 percent.
The BNR has yet to announce a new method of computing the leu's reference exchange rate, which has been frozen at 7,744 lei to the dollar, since February 21.
Last month, the BNR gave up computing the reference rate after allowing 24 banks to act as market makers along with four previously existing dealers.
Leu-dollar retail prices slipped towards 7,000/7,500 compared with around 6,500/7,200 in the morning.
